stemMd: A grant proposal states, "The project will train twenty volunteers to catalog oral histories." Which sentence best maintains its professional tone?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The volunteers will just sort of figure things out.

options.label: B
options.textMd: This thing is going to be ridiculously epic.

options.label: C
options.textMd: We will teach a bunch of cool stuff to whoever shows up.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Participants will receive instruction in recording methods and consent procedures.

explanationMd: A proposal should specify the work in a measured register. Naming recording methods and consent procedures develops the training plan in professional language.

distractorRationale.c: Vague slang conflicts with the proposal's precision.
distractorRationale.b: Promotional excitement replaces the professional account of activities.
distractorRationale.a: This informal vagueness undermines the stated training plan.
